• Plans by the government to increase access
to electricity and rural electrification though
increased power generation to 60% from
the current access of 9% by 2025. (INGA 3
PROJECT).

• Liberalization of power distribution in DRC
which will lead to increased demand for cables
as electrification ramps up.

• Construction opportunities: Expansion of cities
& increased housing projects will drive demand
for electric cables.
